_doc: Spread of a SINGLE-RAIL QAL bank's rail across RANDOM data patterns vs bank size N. Bank of N=8*M gates = M parallel copies of the N=8 anchor unit (C_A*M, L/M, Rs/M, switch width*M), so the circuit is scale-invariant in the activity fraction a=k/N and only the granularity of a changes with N. Source charge and t_ZCS HELD FIXED across patterns = recycle + one fixed flycap top-up. Corrected receiving-side-switch topology. pattern bit 1 = input LOW = output charges. Tests whether sigma_rail falls as 1/sqrt(N) and whether the wander stays above the functional cliff.
